integrity: Analytical proof and exact rational reproducibility code supplied; the 2026 paper already gives the three-person k=1 example, explicitly excluded as a novelty claim.
scientific_limitations: Complete and equally weighted first social layer, fixed connected positively weighted undirected nonbipartite second layer, no self-loops and nonconstant degrees.
Sufficiently long blocks are required for universal parity; the exact three-person example has the stronger comparison for every block.
No assertion about nonlinear opinion models, random switching, behavioral measurements, or global historical priority.
title: Alternating consensus bias under periodic multiplex switching
